primitives.name: Rest Day Duration Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: KC (10/4), CAR (10/5), TB (10/9), and DAL (10/9) had their last log on Aug 21-23, causing rest days to compute as `gameDate - Aug 22 = 56-57 days`.
primitives.assumptions: All teams log once per week; rest day is computed as difference between game date and last log date.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When lastLog < gameDate and gap exceeds 50 days

layer2.mapping: Computed rest days serve as input to Bayesian edge estimation models in GSI.
layer2.telemetry: Mean deviation from expected rest-day range (4–8 days)

primitives.name: Settled Game Log Backfill Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: 77 settled 2026 regular-season NFL games exist in `games` with scores, representing 154 team logs ready for backfill.
primitives.assumptions: Each game produces two team logs; all games have settled scores.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When totalLogs < 154 due to missing data

layer2.mapping: Relational backfill mirrors temporal consistency checks in GSE's game-state graph traversal.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of completed team logs post-backfill

primitives.name: Positive Edge Confidence Threshold
primitives.verbatim_quote: Evaluated remaining 5 games (`NO@NYG`, `TEN@IND`, `PIT@TB`, `DAL@GB`, `BAL@CLE`) with specific positive-edge plays over consensus odds.
primitives.assumptions: Analyst edge is defined as analystOdds > consensusOdds.

layer2.mapping: Edge confidence drives pick selection logic in GSE's decision tree.
layer2.telemetry: Number of picks rejected below threshold
